articles.title: Blue Cloud Softech signs MoU with Ghana firm for African expansion
articles.description: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Ltd signed an MoU with Kasten Development Ltd, Ghana. The partnership aims to expand AI platforms and tech solutions in African markets. A Centre of Excellence will be established in Ghana for product demonstrations. The company reported consolidated revenue of ₹1,002 crore for FY26.
articles.content:

articles.title: CERT-In warns hackers are using AI to target banks and financial institutions
articles.description: CERT-In has issued a critical advisory, stating that a hacker group is using AI to target banks and other financial entities in India. The agency says this attack campaign remains active and could allow the hackers to make unauthorised transfers.
